exposure: Robson Ten Group Classification System (TGCS) group
Analysis by hospital (3 governmental hospitals in Gaza)
TGCS group 1: Nulliparous women with single cephalic full-term pregnancy and spontaneous labor
TGCS group 4: Multiparous with single cephalic full-term pregnancy with induced labor or prelabor cesarean section
TGCS group 10: Single cephalic preterm labor
TGCS group 7: Multiparous with breech presentation
TGCS group 5: Multiparous with single cephalic full-term pregnancy with previous cesarean section
cohort: 18,908 women who gave birth between January 1, 2016 and April 30, 2017 in three governmental hospitals in Gaza
finding: Women in Robson Ten Group Classification System groups 5 (multiparous with single cephalic full-term pregnancy with previous cesarean section), 8 (multiple pregnancies), and 10 (single cephalic preterm labor) were the largest contributors to the overall cesarean section rate.
gest_age: Full-term and preterm mentioned, but specific values not provided
